page_title: NOT 2-1 SHU | Nottingham Forest v Sheffield Utd 18/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+9' Chris Wood (Nottingham) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
90+6' Peter Bankes blows his whistle as Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90+5' What a big chance! Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
90+1' Here's the change. Danilo leaves the pitch and Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) comes on as a substitute.
90+1' Steven Cooper prepares a substitution. Brennan Johnson is replaced by Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham).
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.

89' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Chris Wood (Nottingham) bravely launches himself at a cross from Serge Aurier and gives Wesley Foderingham no chance with a close-range bullet header into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
89' Nottingham are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
86' Peter Bankes rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd).
84' That's the end of the game for Taiwo Awoniyi, who is replaced by Chris Wood (Nottingham).
82' Benie Traore is substituted due to injury. Paul Heckingbottom gives a chance to Antwoine Hackford (Sheffield Utd).
82' It doesn’t look good for Benie Traore (Sheffield Utd); looks like he’ll be heading for an early bath!
81' The game is interrupted now, Benie Traore (Sheffield Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

79' Matt Turner makes a brilliant save! Benie Traore (Sheffield Utd) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
78' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
77' John Egan (Sheffield Utd) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
77' Sheffield Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

76' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sheffield Utd.
75' Neco Williams (Nottingham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
74' The substitution has been made. Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) has replaced William Osula.
74' Joe Worrall (Nottingham) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
72' The referee has issued a yellow card to Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd).
72' That's unlucky! Neco Williams (Nottingham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
69' Steven Cooper has decided to substitute Willy Boly and he is replaced by Anthony Elanga (Nottingham).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Orel Mangala departs the field of play to be replaced by Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
69' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
69' Chris Basham (Sheffield Utd) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Sheffield Utd get a corner.
67' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Peter Bankes blows for a foul.
65' A corner kick by Nottingham is thwarted by the well prepared Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd).
62' Danilo (Nottingham) superbly wins the ball back and has a go from distance, but sends his effort high over the bar.
61' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) will take the corner.
61' Serge Aurier (Nottingham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Problems for Paul Heckingbottom as Vini Souza is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Chris Basham (Sheffield Utd) replaces him.
58' The injury to Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
57' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
56' A goal, which was scored by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham), was disallowed due to offside.
53' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
52' Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the right post.

48' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the top right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Matt Turner, so the score changes to 1:1.
48' Sheffield Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.
47' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

47' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The ball goes out for a corner. Sheffield Utd can continue in their attacking effort.
46' Substitution. Max Lowe did his best and is replaced by Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd).
46' Referee Peter Bankes blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) was probably a bit loose with his words to Peter Bankes, who decides to show him a yellow.
45+2' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
44' The main referee, Peter Bankes, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Serge Aurier (Nottingham) is given a yellow card for dissent.
43' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
43' Brennan Johnson (Nottingham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sheffield Utd.
41' Brennan Johnson (Nottingham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
40' Brennan Johnson (Nottingham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
39' Matt Turner comes off his line to intercept the corner from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd).
38' Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Sheffield Utd have a corner.
36' Willy Boly (Nottingham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Peter Bankes had an easy-decision to make.

34' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the right side of the goal and Matt Turner easily plucks the ball out of the air.
32' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
32' Brennan Johnson (Nottingham) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball is out of play. Nottingham win a corner kick.
31' The corner is swung in but Nottingham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
30' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Wesley Foderingham.
29' Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd) brings an opponent down and Peter Bankes interrupts the game.
27' PENALTY APPEAL after Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
26' Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Matt Turner comes off the line to clear the ball away.
24' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Nottingham will have a throw-in.
21' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
21' Peter Bankes blows his whistle after Scott McKenna (Nottingham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
19' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) whips in a vicious corner direct on goal, but the keeper makes a confident catch on the line.
19' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
19' Serge Aurier (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Nottingham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
18' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) is penalised for holding. Peter Bankes signals a set piece.
17' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It's a throw-in for Nottingham.
17' Scott McKenna (Nottingham) is furious with himself. He pounced on a rebound and from close range directed a header narrowly over the bar!
16' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
16' Serge Aurier (Nottingham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Now Nottingham have a corner.

15' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Wesley Foderingham pulls off an easy save.
12' Dangerous play by Willy Boly (Nottingham). Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Brennan Johnson (Nottingham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

10' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
10' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul. Nottingham win a free kick.
9' Neco Williams (Nottingham) takes the free kick from long distance. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
8' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Matt Turner is prepared to thwart his effort.
7' Brennan Johnson (Nottingham) serves up a nice cross, but Wesley Foderingham punches the ball away.
6' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) steps up to send the ball in.
6' The ball is cleared after Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sheffield Utd.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header in the left side of the goal after a good run and cross by Serge Aurier.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Sheffield Utd will have the kick-off.
Peter Bankes got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
